noProject.title: Open a project to import data
noProject.description: Imported files and datasets are stored in the project file. Create or open a project first.

page.pasteHint: You can also copy a range in Excel and paste it anywhere on this page with Ctrl+V.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.empty: This project has no datasets yet. Import a file to create one.
datasets.size: {alternatives, plural, one {# alternative} other {# alternatives}} · {criteria, plural, one {# criterion} other {# criteria}}

files.title: Original files
files.description: Every imported file is kept in the project byte for byte.
files.empty: No files have been imported yet.

history.title: Import history
history.warnings: {count, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}} reported by this import

profiles.title: Import profiles
profiles.description: A profile remembers how a file was read, so a similar file can be imported in one click.
profiles.empty: No import profiles yet. Save one in the last step of the import wizard.

wizard.title: Import data
wizard.description: Check how Mateo reads your file, then confirm. Nothing is added to the project until the last step.
wizard.blocked: This import has problems that must be fixed before it can be confirmed.

upload.description: Choose an Excel or CSV file, or paste a range copied from a spreadsheet.
upload.accepted: XLSX, XLSM, XLS, CSV and TSV files

paste.label: Paste a table
paste.hint: Copy a range in Excel, click here and press Ctrl+V.

profile.label: Import profile
profile.hint: A saved profile applies the same decisions to this file.
profile.invalid: This import profile cannot be read.

sheet.description: This file has more than one worksheet. Choose the one that holds the decision matrix.
sheet.label: Worksheet
sheet.resetNote: Changing the worksheet resets the choices made for the structure.

structure.description: This is how Mateo read the layout of the file. Change anything that is wrong; the result updates at once.

excluded.title: Rows that were left out
excluded.hint: These rows are not alternatives (titles, totals, ideal solutions, notes), so they were not imported.

columns.description: Choose which columns are criteria and whether each one is a benefit (higher is better) or a cost (lower is better).
columns.directionNeeded: {count, plural, one {# criterion has} other {# criteria have}} no benefit/cost direction in the file. Mateo does not guess it: choose one for each.
columns.name: Criterion

types.description: Check how numbers, text and linguistic terms in the file are read.

number.title: Number format

status.detected: The numbers in the file use one format.
status.not-needed: No number in the file depends on the format.
status.ambiguous: Some numbers read differently in the two formats and nothing in the file decides. Choose the format.
status.conflict: The file mixes both formats. Choose the one to use.

number.samples: Sample values read in each format

scale.label: Linguistic scale
scale.hint: The scale that the linguistic terms in the file belong to.

missing.description: Cells without a value. Mateo never fills a missing value in for you.
missing.count: {count, plural, one {# missing value} other {# missing values}}
missing.fix: Add the values in the file and import it again, or remove the empty row or column.

validation.description: Problems found while reading the file. Errors must be fixed; warnings are saved with the dataset.
validation.directionsMissing: {count, plural, one {# criterion has} other {# criteria have}} no benefit/cost direction yet. Choose it in the Columns step.
validation.warningsHint: Warnings do not block the import. They are saved with the dataset.

preview.description: {alternatives, plural, one {# alternative} other {# alternatives}} and {criteria, plural, one {# criterion} other {# criteria}} will be imported.
preview.none: There is nothing to preview yet.
preview.caption: Preview of the imported decision matrix
preview.weights: The file has a row of weights. It is not imported; weights are set when a method is run.

confirm.description: Check the summary and name the dataset. The original file is saved in the project.
confirm.blocked: The import cannot be confirmed while errors remain. Go back and fix them.
confirm.warnings: {count, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}} will be saved with the dataset.
confirm.saveProfile: Save these decisions as an import profile
confirm.profileHint: Apply it later to files with the same layout.
